sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: passing, backing, parking, intersections and roundabouts
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The extracted text of the parking page repeats the intersection sidebar that is printed on the next page; those intersection facts were assigned only to the page that carries them on its own layout [A03].
The roundabout safety panel says head-on, total and fatal-or-injury crashes went down, but the extracted text shows no percentages, so no reduction figures are stated [A04].
The handbook's statement that circulating traffic does not yield to approaching vehicles is kept as printed, alongside the duty to yield to pedestrians when exiting.
The multi-lane roundabout lane guidance is described as typical in the handbook; signs and pavement markings govern, and the facts say so.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
